answer: Tie standing to a scarce external hardware anchor so each identity costs real capital, and let trust ripen only as several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign a long record of audited work — slow as an orchard bearing fruit over seasons. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so every endorsement traces back on itself and never spans distinct clusters: each clone stays a hollow husk reciting the same empty sonnet, earning nothing. Honest agents root once; the farm must buy a fresh anchor per head, a linear cost that never pays off.
